_readme: Machine-local config for CompanionHelper. On EACH machine, copy this file to 'config.local.json' (git-ignored) in the project root and set only the keys that differ there. DELETE any key you do not need to override - a missing key always falls back to the default in core/config.py, so you keep receiving later default changes on git pull. Keys starting with '_' are notes and are ignored. Windows paths: use forward slashes, e.g. 'C:/Program Files (x86)/...' (a single backslash would break JSON). FFS_JOBS is a JSON array of [label, path-to-.ffs_batch] pairs.
_deck: DECK_PAGES lists the Companion pages this machine's physical decks are mapped to - one entry per deck (e.g. ["1", "2"] for two decks). Every page listed is drawn on startup and keeps its own menu state, so the decks can sit on different menus. OSC_HOST/OSC_PORT is the Companion OSC endpoint this server writes button visuals to.
_pdq: PDQ Deploy is local-only: these paths point at THIS machine's install (Enterprise license + elevated server needed for deploys). PDQ_STATUS_INTERVAL is how often the status page re-reads the deployment journal (running/recent tasks) -- the read copies the whole database, so keep it slower than WEB_REFRESH_INTERVAL.
_touch: The Touch tab's buttons come from TouchDesigner clients (POST /touch/buttons + /touch/ping). These three are only DEFAULTS for a client that sends no host/port/address of its own: where a button press is sent back as OSC. TOUCH_CLIENT_TIMEOUT is how long a client may stay silent before it is dropped from the deck; raise it if a client pings rarely.
_pixelhue: PixelHue Q8 node on this network (default is the venue device; see PIXELHUE_* in core/config.py and PIXELHUE_API_GUIDE.md).
_web: The read-only status page (http://<this machine>:7878/). While a browser has it open, the devices are re-read every WEB_REFRESH_INTERVAL seconds; raise it on a machine whose controllers dislike the extra polling. Reads stop WEB_IDLE_TIMEOUT seconds after the last page request.
_ffs: FreeFileSync is per-machine: the exe path and which batch jobs belong to this machine. FFS_JOBS is an array of [label, path-to-.ffs_batch] pairs.
